title: Prana curated alternative
description: A hand-curated substitution, stored at data/alternatives/<gtin>.json. The alternatives engine in F15 computes suggestions from the catalogue on the device. These records exist only for the cases where computation gets it wrong, or where a person knows something the numbers do not show.

reasons.description: Why this is being suggested. Always comparative and always specific. There is deliberately no generic healthier reason, because that is a claim this project does not make.

blocked.description: Products the engine keeps suggesting that are not actually reasonable substitutes. An explicit deny list beats weakening the ranking rules for everyone.
